data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'karios', meaning 'dear' or 'beloved'. In ancient Greece, it was also a term of endearment for 'care' or 'protection'. The name Caria carries the meaning “Dear, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Caria usually hope their child will grow to embody dear, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Καρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καρία πιθανόν να προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'καρός' που σημαίνει 'ευχαριστία' ή 'χαρμό'. Στο Ευαγγέλιο δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα αυτό, αλλά μπορεί να έχει σχέση με την παράδοση της πρώιμης Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Caria
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Caria originem ducere potest ex voce Latina 'carus' vel 'cantus', quae gaudium et laetitiam significant. In Ecclesia primitiva nomen hoc usitatum non fuit, sed potest habere connexionem cum traditione christiana.
